column2: 战锤=War Hammer  [${} weapon-name template; add 战锤→War Hammer to glossary]
Holds pure life energy, boosting the absorption rate of free energy from the air.
A wellspring of life forever seeking vigorous vitality.
A puppet Furball revived by feeding still-active Gel into a core and soul. It can warn of danger, but carrying it inevitably cramps your style.
Few ever notice the extraordinary power hidden in the Bloodfall Continent's Knife Coins. But the backlash within is not to be underestimated.
A Large Glass Cannon without its fully-evolved form. But hey — the cannon's gone, the glass remains…
An emblem that builds an energy cycle from two attributes of Wildbeast Essence. Greatly increases recovery speed, and adds a little vitality too.
An emblem that builds an energy cycle from three attributes of Wildbeast Essence. Still a bit short of perfection — it lacks some wind-attribute energy…
A shame Moyu Star has no tradition like Shenghuang City's. This money can only be used as one big shield now.
You can even whip one up yourself! It's been buffed, but man, this thing is undercooked…
A sky lantern lit from Fluorescent Essence mixed with Swamp Beast Oil. It disperses the swamp's miasma and briefly stuns Wildbeasts that never see the light.

A forbidden product recorded in the Spaceship Core. Its actual use, however, is just running off to draw aggro… luring in more enemies.
Skyhigh-Tier Rank 1 nullifies it!

Unleashes an extra 25% aura on enemies!
(Loot +25%, XP +39.7%)
PS: No effect on targets Skyhigh-Tier or above, or [BOSS] targets.
The downside is you're visible from two miles off, but a full coat of ice spikes is a treasure that attacks and defends at once! (Agility and such? Godspeed.)
A disco ball assembled from a mass of Iridescent Staff Cores, hard to shatter thanks to Hydrogen Alloy's hardness. It stuns enemies so they can't mount a defense!
The enemies in the Illusory Realm all originate from these crystals; nearby, their minds are at their most slack — effectively granting you stats!

Draw in the Moonwheel crystals, gather your power, charge a single strike. The attack's breadth narrows greatly, but its depth is enough to pierce the hardest Sky-Tier metal.
Skyhigh-Tier Rank 4 nullifies it!
Guess why the Na Family, with no Skyhigh-Tier member, can still do business in Yangang City? This adaptive shield can whittle down even a Skyhigh-Tier Rank 1's attack, layer by layer!
Greatly weakens the vulnerability from 【Deadline】 (5x → 2x), and its duration (60s → 20s).

Damaged, it can't charge beyond 10%, so there's no super-strike to one-shot a Skyhigh-Tier Rank 1. But that also makes its fire rate quite fast, usable as a regular weapon.
Of course, it's still a bit prone to being caught off guard…
An item made from a mountain of 【Bloodspirit Bone Cotton】. When released, its surging blood-aura quickly disorients enemies… it just affects you a little too.
In this world, there is no flower more beautiful than an artificial one.
A cultivation art for Sky-Tier powerhouses; greatly boosts the efficiency of skill-proficiency accumulation, while slightly increasing free-energy absorption.
Release the genetic primal force within your body to melt each shining star across the cosmos. Raises overall XP gain, especially furthering comprehension of the Domain.
A mysterious, elusive advanced art; within its restrained violet radiance lies a heart-stopping power.
The insight to kindle flame with simple psychokinesis.
Psychokinetic flames blaze fiercely, as if to set this whole space alight.
A wholly red flame-beast drifts through the air, the fire-element ripples around it gathering into a sea.
A strange domain formed by harmonizing two conflicting elements. Under this ice-and-fire duality, cold and heat inflict a twofold torment — living things, stay away.

A domain woven from crisscrossing water and fire elements. Amid the water-curtains, a cloth dress like a fairy descending to the mortal world, peerless in its cloud-rising grace; the flames sear, hiding sharp murderous intent — where the blade points, it cleaves the horizon, and moon and stars sink away!

Don't sell Sister! You demon!
(Tip: without Sister, the Crypt won't be nerfed to 1/100 stats.)

Don't sell Sister! You demon!
(Tip: without Sister, the Warship Nexus · B6 won't explode on turn 10.)
As for this one… without the Laser Gun, selling it is fine. But it's a precious one-time item! How could you bear to sell it!
Proof for the brave who dared challenge multiple Icicle Fish. It's only the basic form — perhaps one day it can surpass Sister?
The first upgrade of the Heart of the Barrier Lake. No need to worry about Act 3's Sister becoming useless… she got buffed.
Yet another upgrade of the Heart of the Barrier Lake. Having fun with the Deepfrost Phase-Change Engine~
This isn't even the final form. By the way, this absurdly long material list — is it a bug?
A sword blade forged from Iron Ingot; the core part of an Iron Sword.
A sword blade forged from Steel Ingot, far sharper than an Iron Sword Blade.
A sword blade forged from Copper Ingot, sharp and nimble at once.
A gem-infused sword blade. It holds mana and raises Crit Rate.
A sword blade made of Crypt Metal. Market saturation means it just won't sell, but it's fine for personal use.
A sword blade made of Shadowsteel Ingot. Powerful and heavy-hitting, though a bit unwieldy.
A sword blade made of Charged Alloy Ingot. No negative stats at all — just pure sharpness.
A trident head made of Charged Alloy Ingot. It can punch three holes at once, but is a bit hard to pull out…
A sword blade made of Pulse Alloy Ingot. Later sword blades mainly grow crit and attack speed.
A trident head made of Pulse Alloy Ingot. Basic Attack Multiplier a notch above the Charged Trident Head?
A sword blade made of Blue Gold Ingot. Attack speed and crit rate a notch stronger again.
A trident head made of Blue Gold Ingot. Basic Attack Multiplier a notch stronger again.
A sword blade made of Seagreen Ingot.
A trident head made of Seagreen Ingot.
A sword blade made of Red Steel Ingot.
A trident head made of Red Steel Ingot.
A sword blade made of Mithril Ingot.
A trident head made of Mithril Ingot.
A sword blade made of Melody Alloy Ingot. Melee weapons' potential is fully tapped out — their bonus stats won't grow further.
A trident head made of Melody Alloy Ingot. Melee weapons' potential is fully tapped out — their bonus stats won't grow further.
A sword blade made of Age-Old Frostmarrow. This is a genuine 【cold】 weapon.
A trident head made of Age-Old Frostmarrow. This is a genuine 【cold】 weapon.
A sword blade made of Crystallized Alloy. Time to go make a Moonwheel, isn't it?
A trident head made of Crystallized Alloy. Part XP scales with the amount of material used — I mean, making a Moonwheel isn't a bad deal…
A sword hilt made of white bone. Brittle, so it affects you when used.
A sword hilt made of Copper Bone. Sturdy and handy!
A sword hilt combining several materials. It provides a compound boost!
A sword hilt made of Activated Willow. Genetic primal-energy has never conducted so smoothly!
A sword hilt made of Coiled Crystal. Its transparent look helps analyze primal-energy flow and optimize how you exert force!
A sword hilt made of waxy Solid Gel; light, with fine conduction and feel.
This is the last sword hilt. It looks decent, but it may not really beat 300% Gel…
A basic-model 【Moonwheel】 core. It's… just barely usable.
A 【Moonwheel】 plating made of Mithril Ingot. Clearly unfit as tier-3 psychokinetic-weapon material, but sturdy enough for the first two tiers.
An entry-level 【Moonwheel】 core part. Compared to forcibly-controlled Gel, Light-Dark Branch counts as proper psychokinetic-sensing material.
A 【Moonwheel】 plating made of Melody Alloy Ingot. At B6-tier it's a qualified tier-2 psychokinetic weapon that won't hold back your speed gains.
A 【Moonwheel】 plating made of Age-Old Frostmarrow. A flash of cold light~ I mean a real 【cold light】!
A 【Moonwheel】 plating made of Crystallized Alloy. Once fused, the ice element radiates out better, boosting its power.
A 【Moonwheel】 plating made of Hydrogen Alloy. Hydrogen Alloy is nearly transparent, but the more so, the more dazzling it makes the Wheel Hub.
A low-tier 【Moonwheel】 core part. With it, the Moonwheel finally starts drifting toward a radiant, colorful direction.
A mid-tier 【Moonwheel】 core part. Its anti-gravity field can deceive the eye — meaning enemies get hit before they even see it.
A mid-tier 【Moonwheel】 core part. The crit-multiplier boost has reached its limit… something better comes next!
A 【Moonwheel】 plating made of Raw Gem. Ahem… an A1 Gem Ingot can't make a Wheel Blade. No ambiguity!
A 【Moonwheel】 plating made of Soul Crystal. This is the last 18-ingot cost… beyond this comes the full 36-ingot Moonwheel!
A 【Moonwheel】 plating made of Gaia Alloy. Now it's become the full version!
A 【Moonwheel】 plating made of Ancient Alloy. It's supposed to grow slowly over time, but that got shelved.
A 【Moonwheel】 plating made of Ancient Primal Gold. Say, has no one ever wondered? Why are souls always high-grade material?
A 【Moonwheel】 plating made of Red Tungsten. The Moonwheel's bonus stats will go on balancing forever, just like corruption past level 274…
A common cluster of toxins from the outskirts. The A1-tier alloy "Copper" needs it as a raw material.
The core within Wildbeasts of certain "inner-elixir" cultivation systems. Can draw out immense power in a short time.
The energy crystal within certain "spirits." Can draw out immense power in a short time.
